sahneler.metin: A house fire can turn deadly in as little as two minutes.
The room heats until everything in it ignites at once.
This is flashover, and it is not survivable.
It starts small, but hot gas rises and spreads.
That ceiling layer radiates heat down onto every surface.
The real killer is not the flames. It is the smoke.
A few breaths of toxic smoke can knock you unconscious.
Working smoke alarms cut your risk of dying in half.
